declared_cadence: monthly for bnm_base_rate, bnm_opr, and the interbank rate/volume series; daily for bnm_kijang_emas; daily (weekdays) for bnm_kl_usd_myr and bnm_myor
schema_kind: structured JSON with monthly tabular records and daily intraday series

known_quirks: Reference-current series (bnm_base_rate) have not been republished since 2020-08-06 — content_date stays 2020-08-06 indefinitely, so the row classifies stale despite HTTP 200.
Policy-reference (bnm_opr) is valid until a newer MPC decision supersedes it; the 2026-05-07 decision date is the last policy decision and is not called stale.
Daily series (bnm_kijang_emas) is declared daily but the probe shows a content_date lag; it is a live-cycle daily reference price, not dormant.
All declared-cadence monthly series have no Last-Modified HTTP header; rely on row content_date only.
Intraday series (bnm_kl_usd_myr) emit 4× daily snapshots at 0900 / 1130 / 1200 / 1700 MYT; status=fresh requires matching the day.

known_false_positives.description: HTTP 200 returns content with stale content_date. bnm_base_rate is a stale reference-current table (HTTP 200 but not current bank rates) and bnm_kijang_emas is a daily live-cycle series lagging its declared cadence; both report status=stale while the endpoint is healthy.
known_false_positives.detection_signal: status=stale AND http_status=200 AND content_date older than the declared cadence window

known_false_negatives: BNM sometimes returns stale HTTP 304 with content_date in the body; current probe rule does not parse 304 separately. Mitigate by treating 304 same as 200.
rate_limit_or_robots: Undocumented public endpoint; no rate-limit header observed. Probe at 5-min cycle has not triggered any backoff.

failure_examples.cause: Row content_date=2020-08-06; reference-current table has not republished since 2020, so its current-rate contents are stale.
failure_examples.resolution: Documented as expected; classify reference-current via the normal freshness clock.

failure_examples.cause: policy-reference is valid until a newer MPC decision supersedes it; the 2026-05-07 decision is current.
failure_examples.resolution: Expected; do not flag as a regression.

failure_examples.cause: Row content_date lags the declared daily cadence; live-cycle daily series.
failure_examples.resolution: Check API publishing frequency; possible declared-cadence drift.

current_probe_rule: scripts/probe_bnm.py (or equivalent probe) does a GET to the per-dataset endpoint, parses the JSON, reads the row's date column as content_date, computes days_since_content_date and applies the standard 10-status taxonomy. reference and policy-reference carry no freshness clock (status=reference); reference-current is subject to the normal freshness classification and reports stale when its content_date is old.
